question: Is the following sentence plausible? "Keenan Allen drew a flag on the play in the NFC championship."

He is a wide receiver for the Los Angeles Chargers (formerly San Diego Chargers).

The American Football Conference (AFC).

It is the championship game for the National Football Conference.
